```{r setup, echo=FALSE}
library(devoirs3)
devoirs3::devoirs_start(docID = "devoirs3-word-or-phrase-1-one")
```

```{devoirs_choices word_or_phrase_1_one_choices}
- A highlighted term that carries a defined meaning beyond its ordinary conversational use.:
    correct: true
    feedback: Correct.
- A phrase that must contain exactly two words.:
    correct: false
    feedback: The term may be one word or several words; there is no fixed length
      requirement.
- A rule that transforms givens into new beliefs.:
    correct: false
    feedback: That describes reasoning; a word or phrase is a vocabulary expression.
- A word that can only be used in casual conversation.:
    correct: false
    feedback: The term is highlighted precisely because it has a technical meaning
      beyond casual usage.
```

Only one of the following is a valid description of word or phrase. Mark that one.

```{r}
devoirs3::devoirs_selection(
  label = "word-or-phrase-1-one",
  question = "Only one of the following is a valid description of word or phrase. Mark that one.",
  answers = word_or_phrase_1_one_choices,
  multiple = FALSE
)()
```
